title: Filtering the catalogue narrows, empties and clears, and a demo's source copies exactly
intent: The /components directory sections the catalogue by group with counts and catalogue numbers; the filter narrows across every group, hides each group with no match, shows the empty state when nothing matches and clears back to the whole catalogue; a result opens from the keyboard with a visible focus ring; and on /components/button the live demo renders while its copy control writes the displayed source to the clipboard.

fixtures.name: catalogue queries and the copied demo

preconditions: The search starts empty and the directory shows every component in six group sections, Forms, Overlays, Data display, Navigation, Feedback and Layout, each alphabetical, without release groups, sort controls, or pagination.
The context grants clipboard read and write to the served origin only.

steps.expect: Every component appears once, in the six group sections in display order, each heading carrying its count, and the status gives the total count and A–Z order.

steps.action: On /components, type dialog into Filter components.
steps.expect: The status counts fewer components than the whole catalogue, Dialog is listed, every listed entry mentions dialog, and only Overlays remains: every group without a match is hidden.

steps.action: Replace the query with one that matches nothing.
steps.expect: The status reads 0 components and the No components match these filters empty state appears.

steps.action: Press the empty state's Clear filters.
steps.expect: The query is empty, focus is back in Filter components and the status counts the whole catalogue.

steps.action: Type button, press Tab until the Button entry has focus, then press Enter.
steps.expect: The entry shows the focus ring, and /components/button opens with the heading Button.

steps.action: In the first demo, select Code and press Copy example source, then return to Preview.
steps.expect: Code displays the exact demo source and the 28px copy control writes it to the clipboard; Preview restores the live buttons with Ultima default radii.
